q1_issues.issue: The proper noun "American Idol" is dropped entirely — it gets no symbol and no Name atom, though the instruction set makes both non-optional for every proper noun including a named work, and the winner/runner-up-of-American-Idol link disappears with it.
The measure scale `earnings` is not a surface dimension word — the sentence states no measure verb or noun, whereas the scale rule requires recording the dimension actually said.
The focus particle "only" in "with only $2.9 million" is dropped with no Only atom and no other trace.

q2_gaps: A proper-noun modifier on a common-noun head ("American Idol" winner / runner-up): the compound-concepts rules explicitly exclude proper nouns, and no relation head is licensed to link the person to the named contest.
A focus particle on a bare money/measure amount ("only $2.9 million"): like the registered "only one N" gap, there is no filler symbol for Only to attach to.
A chart/box-office rank ("opened at No. 11"): Ordinal's scale slot is defined as the associated event or an explicit "-est" dimension, not a position on an external ranking.
notes: The "starring" participial post-modifier is correctly taken as a reduced relative with the film as Agent, and the coordinated object correctly distributes into two star events. Patient for the intransitive "opened" matches the instruction set's own festival example.
